newsitem.title: UK: EMI rises on favourable press comment.
newsitem.headline: EMI rises on favourable press comment.

text.p: Shares of EMI, one of the world's major music companies, rose on Wednesday following a favourable report by Financial Times, which said the company's maiden interim results were a hit with investors.
The shares rose 25-1/2p at 1,320p by 0838 GMT, with 181,852 shares changing hands.

The newspaper said in its influential Lex column: "..The global music market grew by only 2.5 percent in the six months to December. This makes an alarming contrast with EMI's 50 percent prospective price/earnings premium to the stock market average."
